title: Two Empires Almost Went to War Over One Pig 🐷 #shorts
description:
In 1859 an American farmer on San Juan Island shot a British pig. Soldiers, warships and cannons followed. Nobody fired, both armies camped there for twelve years, and a German emperor finally settled the border. The only casualty: one pig.

Believe It Or Bear: true stories, twist endings. Follow for more.
